goal: Add a default-deny PLAN_ONLY execution-admission boundary that validates one control-loop decision against the exact delegated reusable authority and current transaction evidence without executing any mutation.
scope: consume one exact autonomous continuation control-loop decision bound to fresh current provider truth
validate that any proposed mutation path names exactly one existing canonical reusable authority and satisfies its required transaction evidence
distinguish wait, stop, blocked and separately-authorized recovery states from mutation-admission candidates
emit only PLAN_ONLY admission evidence with exact target action and authority identity; perform no delegated mutation
fail closed on authority-anchor drift, stale main, selected Work Unit drift, lease or PR drift, incomplete CI evidence or contradictory control-loop state
keep any reusable autonomous continuation executor behind a separate explicit Owner Authorization boundary
forbidden_scope: grant or execute Issue-create, Issue-update, branch, pull-request, provider-state, Writer Lease, workflow-rerun, merge or Issue-close authority
mutate product/runtime source or runtime state
mutate ADWF Consumer binding/provenance or the ADWF repository
perform release/tag/promotion, ruleset/policy administration, PRIVATE evidence publication or 1080/1081 lifecycle mutation
exit_criteria: every control-loop decision maps deterministically to wait, stop, block or one exact existing delegated authority
admission never converts a PLAN_ONLY decision into mutation authority
post-merge close recovery remains bound to exact released lease, merged PR and current-main merge readback
all unknown, stale, contradictory or incomplete inputs fail closed
a future reusable autonomous executor remains separately prepared and explicitly Owner-authorized
exact-head hosted CI passes with no provider-state, ADWF, product/runtime or 1080/1081 mutation
